name: clientell
label: Clientell MCP
selection: The tools of clientell-org.json, and Clientell's live reads of the org: use_connector, only with the provider salesforce (its actions query, tooling_query, describe and limits; read-only, no create, update, delete or deploy), and list_connector_capabilities. The metadata index holds no Apex source, custom metadata records or picklist values; Clientell's own answers send the agent to use_connector for them. use_connector is marked destructive because other providers (Slack, Jira) can write: the proxy refuses it with any provider but salesforce. Part 2's Clientell arm (docs/mcp-study.md); clientell-org.json, without the live reads, is kept as a check.
note: There is no network access except the clientell tools, which reach Clientell's Salesforce MCP server and, through it, the org this task is about; there is no org to deploy to or run tests in.
